examples.label: Recursive Fibonacci
examples.source: i32 fib(i32 x){if x<2{return x;}return fib(x-1)+fib(x-2);}i32 main(){print("{}\n",fib(10));return 7;}

examples.label: Loops and branches
examples.source: i32 main(){i32 sum=0;for i32 i=0;i<10;i++{if i==2{continue;}if i==6{break;}sum+=i;}while sum<20{sum++;}if sum==20{print("ok ");}else{print("bad ");}print("{}\n",sum);return 0;}
